snippet.title: Monkey Tales Games Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/320020
Developed by leading educational publisher DieKeure and Larian Studios through four years of close collaboration with teachers, schools, and universities, Monkey Tales Games is a series of engrossing video games with a robust learning component tailored to every child.
